correction.text: the Fezzan 'from Sokna in the north to Murzuq in the south', 'and into present-day Chad and Niger'

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. region.text: the Fezzan, the Sultanate of the Awlad Muhammad

ledger.note: 1811: the Karamanli occupy the Fezzan and the dynasty ends. 'occupied in 1811/1812'; the Awlad Muhammad page says the dynasty held power 'until 1812' and that in 1807 Yusuf 'brought the tribes of Fezzan under direct control'. 1811 matches the Karamanli dossier.

wars.name: Ottoman conquest of the Fezzan
wars.outcome: Ottoman Tripolitania under Mahmut bey invaded and occupied the Fezzan in 1574 (most African historians say 1577) and expelled Sultan Bulalah Muhammad; Bornu 'would aid them militarily against the Ottoman annexation'. The Tripoli beylerbey later 'granted Fezzan their autonomy in their own internal affairs' against taxes: 4,000 mithqals of gold a year plus 2,000 in gold dust and 2,000 in slaves.
wars.note: The Fezzan page says the Fezzan was 'vassalised from 1574' and its rulers pledged allegiance to the sultan in the 1580s; the Murzuk page says 'local control stayed with the Sultan of Fezzan' under a garrison. The ledger enters 1574-1639 as an occupation because the Awlad Muhammad page has an Ottoman bey overthrown in 1639; the pages are not reconciled.

wars.name: Overthrow of the Ottoman bey in the Fezzan
wars.outcome: Muhammad bin Juhaym 'overthrew the Ottoman Bey in 1639, and assumed control'.

wars.name: Karamanli conquest of the Fezzan
wars.outcome: Yusuf Karamanli 'brought the tribes of Fezzan under direct control' in 1807 and the Fezzan was 'occupied in 1811/1812', ending the dynasty.
wars.note: The Awlad Muhammad page ends the dynasty in 1812; the dossier uses 1811 with the Karamanli dossier.

certainty.note: A Saharan oasis sultanate: no page gives a frontier; the Chad and Niger reach is not drawn.

notes: Cliopatria has no Fezzan row. Start 1550 is the Awlad Muhammad page's 'from 1550 to 1812'; the Murzuk page puts the founder's rise 'early in the 16th century' and the Awlad page also says 'from the late 15th century'. The sibling Karamanli dossier records the Fezzan as a vassal 1807-1811 under the string 'Fezzan (Awlad Muhammad dynasty)'; the ottoman-empire and ottoman-tripolitania dossiers should carry the Ottoman suzerainty from 1574 (Fezzan page: 'vassalised from 1574') with this dossier's slug as counterpart. The 1574-1639 gap is the page-literal reading of 'invaded and occupied' and 'overthrew the Ottoman Bey in 1639'; the same pages call the Fezzan an autonomous tributary, so a reviewer may prefer a vassal reading (no event is entered for it). The occupations of 1690, 1716, 1718 name only a year; the Fezzan page does not name the occupier, and the Ottoman and Karamanli counterparts are the researcher's reading. The Awlad Muhammad page names no sultan except Bulalah Muhammad (1574) and Muhammad bin Juhaym (1639), so no ruler strip is entered. Gazetteer: Fezzan and Marzuq resolve; Sokna (Al Jufrah district, c. 29.05 N 15.9 E) is not a gazetteer place, so a 100 km circle by coordinates stands in for 'Sokna in the north' - listed as needed. [Fix fx-40, 2 Nov 2026, R069] ledger/3-10 (the four occupations 1679-1682, 1690-1691, 1716-1717, 1718-1719) are occupation_start / occupation_end instead of loss / gain: the dynasty keeps its land and is drawn under an occupation tint. The p1670-p1679 patch (events/1-3) does the same for 1679-1682 and is now redundant.
